A '''pitiful zombie''' (also called '''What's that smell?''', '''Stinky man''' and '''Needs ointment''') is [[Thok]]'s name for a [[Zombie (Dungeoneering)|zombie]] encountered during [[Thok Your Block Off (saga)|Thok Your Block Off]]. Thok easily kills it.
